profile.headline: Frontend Software Engineer
profile.summary: Front-end engineer with additional experience in design systems, marketing, SEO, social media management, and e-commerce development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Started as a Software Engineer on the the Prototyping team supporting .com efforts, maintaining global stylesheets, and internal prototyping tool. Contributed to foundation efforts for the design system and built some of the first shared components. Moved into Software Engineer role building and maintaining Nike.com. 

Al-Augmented Engineering & Agentic Workflows
* ﻿﻿Utilized a library of 20+ custom Al agent "Skills" spanning the full software development lifecycle — from Jira ticket intake and branch creation through implementation, build verification, and automated PR review trage - reducing context-switching and time-to-PR on feature tickets
* ﻿﻿Worked in an end-to-end agentic workflow integrating Cursor Al with Jira, GitHub, Figma, Slack, Confluence, and Adobe Target APls, enabling a single natural-language prompt to drivewulti-step cross-tool processes with human-in-the-loop approval gates
* ﻿﻿Participated in a plan-first, approval-gated implementation pattern across all agent workflows, ensuring Al generates a scope/risk/test plan before touching code and does not proceed without explicit developer sign-off
* ﻿﻿Utilized a custom webpack bundle analysis workflow pairing static stats. json analysis with Chrome DevTools runtime coverage data, enabling Al-assisted identification and removal of unused dependencies
* ﻿Utilized an automated PR feedback triage workflow that ingests comments from GitHub Copilot, Cursor Bugbot, and human reviewers via GraphQL, classifies each as Accept/Reject/Defer, and implements approved fixes

positions.title: Designer/Developer
positions.description: Brand Identity Design, Website Design, Website and E-commerce Development for outdoor athletes and the brands that support them.

positions.title: Student: 800+ hours of advanced in-person training in full-stack JavaScript software development
positions.description: After years of dabbling with self-taught web development skills, I'm taking a leap to level-up! I'm looking forward to being a professional developer capable of contributing to advanced digital projects that serve the outdoor industry and conservation efforts.

positions.title: Director of Career Services & Outreach
positions.description:
As a hub for Portland’s tech community, Alchemy Code Lab operates with a finger on the pulse of the industry. Because our course offerings evolve and expand alongside innovations in software development, our students hit the ground running with the most current toolsets in the field. We seek collaborations with the experts and organizations that are driving our city’s tech future, providing insider access to the industry that can’t be had through typical coding bootcamps.

Professionalism is at the core of what we teach and how we function. Our approach is holistic: we don’t just teach “getting it to work.” Instead, we encourage the practice of writing quality code that can be sustained and maintained -- now, and by developers down the road. We live what we teach, and support each other in passion projects and creative endeavors. 

Ask me about hiring our graduates, hosting an event on campus, or teaching opportunities!

positions.title: Director of Marketing & Outreach
positions.description: Alchemy Code Lab offers the most advanced coding instruction in Portland, launching developers into professional careers. Our mission is to generate real opportunity for the next generation of local developers to drive Portland's creative future. We empower diversity, ignite potential, cultivate fluency & fuel possibility.

positions.title: Talent Manager (full cycle recruiter)
positions.description: When I started at 52 as a Talent Coordinator, I used my administrative skills and knack for integrating digital tools into workflows to help whip internal staffing processes into shape. I evaluated incoming portfolios and brought top talent to the attention of the Talent Managers. For stretches of time, I managed all social media efforts and coordinated with an SEO specialist and web developers to enhance 52’s social digital presence. As Talent Manager, I got out from behind my computer to interview candidates, attend portfolio critiques, and design community events. I met with clients to get to know their needs, and connected them with great candidates for contract and permanent roles. Competitive vendor managed staffing programs for Nike, eBay, and Intel were also my responsibility as the internal 52 team grew and shifted. My personal interest in interactive design and development propelled 52 Limited’s engagement with the developer community in Portland. I thrived in this small-team environment that demanded attention to detail, flexibility, intuition, and compassionate communication at a non-stop pace.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
Administrative “hub” for 30-person branding and advertising agency in downtown Portland.

I kept everyone caffeinated, informed, coordinated, and supplied. I provided detailed reporting and tracking of project statuses, resources, and finances to Creative and Account teams and kept the Executive Leadership Team in the loop with top level project financial reports.

positions.title: Office Manager
positions.description:
While attending school full time, I managed the operations side of the firm for 32 hours a week.

I executed accounts payable, receivable, payroll and benefits administration. My design skills were put to use in keeping the company print portfolio updated, preparing and printing client presentation materials and facilitating a complete website redesign and implementation.

positions.title: Marketing Manager
positions.description:
Moved my way up from Receptionist, to Administrative Assistant, to Project Manager Assistant, to Marketing Manager before going back to school full time. 

Interstate Mechanical provided large scale contracting services to clients such as Intel, Amy's Foods, Portland State University, and Hynix Semi Conductor.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Sensing the Environment:  A Citizen Science/Connected Learning project

A series of collaborative projects between Make+Think+Code@PNCA, Intel, and the Sandy River Basin Watershed Council to use art, science and technology to better understand our ecosystems, and the habitats and behaviours of birds and other life that shares our environment.
